metadata.title: TN Lens · Tamil Nadu 2031 Development
metadata.description: From public intentions and civic aspirations to measurable resident outcomes, feasible policies, pilots and verifiable accountability. No voter targeting or election forecasting.

context.label: Projected Tamil Nadu GSDP
context.caveat: Current-price economic projection, not realised household income.

context.label: Expenditure excluding debt repayment
context.caveat: Total planned net spending, not discretionary funding for new policies.

context.label: Committed spending / revenue receipts
context.caveat: Salary, pensions and interest; limits fiscal room.

context.label: Tamil Nadu SDG Index
context.caveat: Dated 2023–24 measure, not a 2026 status assessment.

outcomes.title: Productive jobs and real earnings
outcomes.intent: Create durable livelihoods and rising household earning capacity
outcomes.intent_attribution: Independent research candidate; not a statement or pledge by WTL
outcomes.outcome: More residents experience secure productive employment and real income growth

north_star.indicator: Comparable inflation-adjusted earnings and sustained job retention
north_star.source_to_validate: MoSPI PLFS, Tamil Nadu state statistics and independently validated cohort results

constraints: Programme attendance does not establish sustained employment
District earnings may lack a comparable dataset
Pilot costs and job displacement effects require examination
outcomes.pilot: Verify six-month employment retention for one consent-based skilling cohort
outcomes.next_evidence: Confirm the methodology and coverage of an official employment and earnings baseline.

outcomes.title: School learning and future opportunity
outcomes.intent: Enable stronger foundational learning and pathways to productive life
outcomes.intent_attribution: Independent research candidate; not a statement or pledge by WTL
outcomes.outcome: More children demonstrate learning gains and successful transitions

north_star.indicator: Comparable foundational learning proficiency and progress
north_star.source_to_validate: National Achievement Survey, state assessment sources and UDISE+

constraints: Do not publish child-level identifiable records
Test design must be comparable
Causal claims require careful evaluation
outcomes.pilot: Pilot permission-based learning support with baseline and comparable follow-up assessments
outcomes.next_evidence: Select one publicly documented and comparable assessment series.

outcomes.title: Dependable primary care and prevention
outcomes.intent: Make essential preventive and primary healthcare reliable and accessible
outcomes.intent_attribution: Independent research candidate; not a statement or pledge by WTL
outcomes.outcome: Better continuity of basic care without collecting private medical histories

north_star.indicator: Aggregated service availability and care-continuity indicators
north_star.source_to_validate: NFHS district fact sheets and Tamil Nadu official health data

constraints: Do not collect identifiable patient information
Administrative throughput differs from population health outcomes
Service data needs coverage checks
outcomes.pilot: Audit facility service reliability in a cooperating area and publish only aggregate findings
outcomes.next_evidence: Ingest a small set of dated comparable official district health indicators.

outcomes.title: Reliable water and climate resilience
outcomes.intent: Improve reliable safe water delivery and reduce disruption from floods and droughts
outcomes.intent_attribution: Independent research candidate; not a statement or pledge by WTL
outcomes.outcome: More households experience reliable water and fewer days of service interruption

north_star.indicator: Verified water service continuity and quality compliance
north_star.source_to_validate: Municipal water utilities and state water / public health statistics

constraints: Connection totals are not service continuity
Weather and rainfall require contextual controls
Operating and capital funding differ
outcomes.pilot: Measure water quality and interruption hours with one consenting service provider
outcomes.next_evidence: Find published municipal water-continuity and quality measurement standards.

outcomes.title: Environmental outcomes, not event counts
outcomes.intent: Clean and Sustainable Tamil Nadu — published programme theme
outcomes.intent_attribution: WTL published programme theme, not a quantified 2031 pledge
outcomes.outcome: More surviving suitable trees and documented waste-disposal outcomes

north_star.indicator: Independently measured survival after 90 and 180 days
north_star.source_to_validate: WTL site records, local land and forestry records, independent random sampling

constraints: Organisation planting totals are outputs, not impact
Convenience samples cannot establish state outcomes
Land rights and aftercare may constrain follow-through
outcomes.pilot: Sample recorded planting sites at random and publish method, uncertainty and survival
outcomes.next_evidence: Obtain a site-level sampling frame and repeat measurements.

outcomes.title: Accessible and safer public facilities
outcomes.intent: Women Safety and Empowerment — published programme theme
outcomes.intent_attribution: WTL published programme theme, not a quantified 2031 pledge
outcomes.outcome: Public spaces and services address observable access and safety defects

north_star.indicator: Verified repair of public-facility defects within published service standards
north_star.source_to_validate: Municipal asset and maintenance registers, audited public facilities

constraints: A facility audit is not a measure of crime prevalence
Never expose victim records or personal locations
Survey evidence must be interpreted carefully
outcomes.pilot: With municipal consent audit streetlights and transit waiting areas with no personal reports
outcomes.next_evidence: Agree a public facility standard and follow the official repair process.

outcomes.title: Public services with verified resolution
outcomes.intent: Ensure public institutions can be held to transparent and measurable service standards
outcomes.intent_attribution: Independent research candidate; not a statement or pledge by WTL
outcomes.outcome: More public-service problems are resolved with durable, independently checked outcomes

north_star.indicator: Verified complaint resolution and elapsed response time
north_star.source_to_validate: Local grievance portals, public works completion reports and independent outcome checks

constraints: Closing a ticket is not proof of resolved service
Existing authorities must agree to participate
Financial and privacy controls are required
outcomes.pilot: Cooperate with one local authority on streetlight or drainage case closure verification
outcomes.next_evidence: Confirm an institutional counterpart, baseline throughput and resolution definition.

stages: Publicly stated intention or clearly labelled independent aspiration
State / district starting point and source quality
Policy alternatives, legal powers and responsible institutions
Fiscal cost, trade-offs and implementation conditions
Small voluntary pilot and independently reviewable comparison
Observed public benefit, contrary evidence and corrections
safeguards: No political endorsement or fictional candidate pledge
No inferred voter preferences, scores or election forecasts
No implied causality from event or engagement counts
Keep unverified baselines and future numerical targets empty
Avoid identifiable health, safety, education and personal records
